frequency_question: How often do expiring water treaties secure a signed successor agreement before or near expiration, given that visible technical committee talks are ongoing?
membership_rule: Includes major international river basin treaties reaching a formal expiration date where predecessor frameworks existed. Excludes domestic water pacts or unilateral declarations.

cases.name: US-Mexico Colorado River Salinity (1973 Minute 242 succeeded by later minutes/agreements)
Lesotho Highlands Water Project Phase agreements
Columbia River Treaty regime reviews and renegotiation talks
Southern African Development Community (SADC) Revised Protocol updates

provenance_note: 6 cases named, 7 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 6 named cases; estimated roughly 7 major comparable renegotiation processes globally in this specific institutional class.
known_gaps: Excludes minor bilateral arrangements without published treaty texts or formalized commission oversight.
skeleton: Global transboundary water basin renewals under joint river commissions where technical committees met prior to expiration.
multiplier: 6 observed successes out of 7 major historical instances where expiring frameworks underwent structured succession processes.
validity_reason: International water law frameworks and basin commission norms evolve slowly over decade-long horizons.
